items.raw_excerpt: A Metro grocery store in Ottawa's South Keys neighbourhood will be replaced by a Food Basics this fall, costing dozens of employees their jobs.
items.summary_en: A Metro store in Ottawa's South Keys neighborhood will become a Food Basics this fall. Dozens of employees will lose their jobs because of the change. Workers call the news a hard blow.

items.title_original: Workers say potential unemployment as an Ottawa Metro converts to Food Basics 'an absolute gut punch'

items.raw_excerpt: The pristine white sand dunes of the Lençóis Maranhenses National Park are bordered by thick jungle on one side and the Atlantic Ocean on the other. Thousands of lagoons fill up after the rainy season.
items.summary_en: Lencois Maranhenses National Park has huge white sand dunes. After the rainy season, thousands of freshwater lagoons fill up between the dunes. The park sits between a thick jungle and the Atlantic Ocean.

items.title_en: Surreal sand dunes dotted with freshwater lagoons in Brazil

items.raw_excerpt: Whether it is in a tent, caravan, or mobile home: wild camping in Switzerland is only permitted in certain locations and under special conditions. Here’s what you need to know,
items.summary_en: Wild camping in Switzerland is only allowed in certain places and under special conditions. It could be in a tent, a caravan, or a mobile home. You should know the rules before you go.

items.raw_excerpt: Fewer than 100 of the roughly 4,000 juniper bushes that grew in the Boschhuizerbergen nature reserve near Venray have survived this month’s wildfire in northern Limburg, the foundation that manages the site says. The reserve held the largest juniper shrubland in the southern Netherlands, according to Het Limburgs Landschap, with some bushes more than 130 years old. Junipers grow slowly and thrive in the reserve’s nutrient-poor, drifting-sand soil – conditions that have become rare in the region.
items.summary_en: Fewer than 100 of about 4,000 juniper bushes survived a wildfire near Venray. The reserve held the largest juniper shrubland in the southern Netherlands. Some bushes were more than 130 years old.
items.summary_ko: 벤라이 인근 자연보호구역에서 난 산불로 향나무 약 4천 그루 중 100그루 미만만 살아남았다. 이곳은 네덜란드 남부에서 가장 큰 향나무 군락이었으며, 일부 나무는 수령이 130년이 넘었다.
items.title_en: Wildfire destroys rare juniper shrubland in Limburg
items.title_ko: 림뷔르흐 산불로 희귀 향나무 군락 사라져
items.title_original: Limburg wildfire wiped out rare juniper shrubland

items.raw_excerpt: The Saskatoon team heads to France Wednesday for the festival. The sport is helpful for recovering and building strength after surgeries, but team members say they stay in the program because of the life-long connections between women with a shared story.
items.summary_en: A Saskatoon dragon boat team of breast cancer survivors is going to France for an international festival. The sport helps them recover and build strength after surgeries. They stay in the program because of the life-long friendships they share with other women.

items.raw_excerpt: Carvoeiro is set to become an open-air stage for contemporary art this month as the Festival PARAGEM returns to Lagoa for its eighth edition, bringing performances, installations, drawing and experimental music into the heart of the Algarve’s summer season.
items.summary_en: The PARAGEM festival turns Carvoeiro into an open-air stage for contemporary art this month. It is the eighth edition and takes place in Lagoa. Visitors can see performances, installations, drawing and experimental music in the heart of the Algarve summer.

items.raw_excerpt: El exgolero analizó duramente el nivel del cuadro precordillerano tras el empate 1-1 ante Estudiantes de La Plata.
items.summary_en: Ex-goalkeeper Johnny Herrera sharply criticized the level of Universidad Catolica after the 1-1 draw with Estudiantes de La Plata. He questioned whether any UC player would be a starter at rivals La U or Colo Colo.

items.raw_excerpt: Unless you’ve been living under a rock somewhere (or, if you are really lucky, in an ice igloo), then you know that a rare solar eclipse will happen tonight. But will everyone be able to enjoy it - safely?
items.summary_en: A rare solar eclipse will happen over Switzerland tonight. Not everyone will be able to watch it safely. People need to protect their eyes when looking at it.

items.raw_excerpt: Austria will get a deep partial solar eclipse on Wednesday evening, with clear skies expected across the country. But with the Sun already low in the west, finding the right viewing spot will be crucial.
items.summary_en: Austria will see a deep partial solar eclipse on Wednesday evening. Clear skies are expected across the country. The Sun will be low in the west, so choosing a good viewing spot is important.
